name: OpenProject
description: OpenProject: projects, work packages with their activities, versions, time entries, users and statuses, queried with OpenProject's filter grammar. API v3, Basic auth with the literal username `apikey`.
instructions:
**Getting a key**
1. In OpenProject open **My Account → Access tokens** and generate an **API token**.
2. Set `OPENPROJECT_URL` to your instance root (no trailing slash) and `OPENPROJECT_API_KEY` to the token.

**The Basic-auth username is the literal string `apikey`.** Not your login name — the word `apikey`, with the token as the password. This adapter does it for you, and it is the first thing to check when a token you know is valid returns 401.

**Permissions follow the user.** The token inherits its owner's project memberships and roles. A project the user is not a member of is simply absent from the results, not an error.

**Filters are a JSON array of single-key objects**: `[{"status":{"operator":"o","values":[]}},{"assignee":{"operator":"=","values":["42"]}}]`. Operators are OpenProject's own short codes — `o` open, `c` closed, `=` equals, `!` not, `~` contains, `<>d` between dates, `t` today, `>t-` in the last N days. The filter string is passed through verbatim so the whole grammar stays available.

**Responses are HAL+JSON.** Rows live in `_embedded.elements`, related resources are links under `_links` and paging is `_links.nextByOffset`. Fields like `assignee` arrive as a link with a `title`, which is usually the readable name you want without another call.

**Durations are ISO 8601**: `estimatedTime` of `PT8H` is eight hours, `P2D` is two days. They are not numbers.

**Self-hosted, which is the thing to plan for.**
- On **AnythingMCP Cloud** the instance must be reachable from the public internet on a real hostname with a valid TLS certificate. A self-signed certificate will fail: the connector offers no trust-anything switch.
- On an internal host (`op.intern`, `10.0.0.x`), self-host AnythingMCP on the same network and add that host to `SSRF_ALLOWED_HOSTS`, or the outbound guard refuses the call before it is made.

tools.name: openproject_get_me
tools.description: Read the user the API token belongs to, with their name, e-mail, language and admin flag. The fastest way to see whose projects this connector can see.

tools.name: openproject_list_projects
tools.description: List projects with their identifier, name, status, description and active flag. The map of what this token can reach.

tools.name: openproject_list_work_packages
tools.description: List work packages — tasks, bugs, features, milestones — across all projects, with their type, status, assignee, dates and priority.

filters.description: Filter JSON, e.g. [{"status":{"operator":"o","values":[]}}] for open ones.

tools.name: openproject_list_project_work_packages
tools.description: List the work packages inside one project — the usual scope for 'what is open on this project' and much cheaper than filtering globally.

tools.name: openproject_get_work_package
tools.description: Read one work package in full: description, type, status, assignee, dates, estimated and spent time, and its custom fields.

tools.name: openproject_list_work_package_activities
tools.description: Read the activity stream of one work package: every comment and field change in order, with author and timestamp.

tools.name: openproject_list_time_entries
tools.description: List logged time entries with their user, work package, date, hours and comment — the raw data behind any effort report.

tools.name: openproject_list_versions
tools.description: List versions (releases and sprints) with their name, status, due date and the project they belong to.

tools.name: openproject_list_users
tools.description: List users with their name, e-mail, login and status, to resolve who a work package is assigned to. Requires an administrator token on most instances.

tools.name: openproject_list_statuses
tools.description: List the work-package statuses this instance defines, with their id, name and whether each counts as closed. Needed to read a status filter correctly.
